answer: A copied signing key still cannot un-consume a sealed lot. Attestation requires destroying one serialized vial of walnut tannin spiked with a yarrow marker, then filing a spiral plate chromatogram whose origin spot is mixed with the epoch seed. Labs retire that vial ID on first use, and a second address reusing it is refused. Each identity therefore spends a fresh vial and plate run, so clone cost grows linearly. Assumed costs only, not a vendor quote: $95 a vial and $40 to read the plate; 120 fabricated identities cost $16,200.
